title: CSV rerun keep-original launch request
summary: Keep executable CSV rerun original-source handling on keep-original from the WebView request builder, even when stale or manual original-action selections are present.
reason: The Launch page could submit original_policy=hold_then_delete_after_publish for CSV rerun starts. A stale backend could pass that disabled original-source action to Invoke-RerunCsv.ps1, which then exited before pipeline events were written.
behavior_before: The CSV rerun policy selector exposed original-source rename/hold/delete choices, auto replacement could resolve to move_to_hold_after_publish, and stale hold/delete selections could be submitted with confirm_original_policy and confirm_delete_original.
behavior_after: The WebView selector exposes only auto/keep for Original After Proof, request collection always resolves original_policy to keep for executable CSV reruns, and launch/preflight copy reflects that cleanup handoff is separate from CSV rerun launch.
tests_added: Updated WebView launch request smoke coverage so stale hold/delete original selections resolve to original_policy=keep and do not send original/delete confirmations.
Updated WebView launch preflight/static tests for keep-original replacement copy and disabled original-source action warnings.
manual_validation: Ran .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe .\ops\scripts\dev\run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --changed; summaries refreshed for changed WebView/test files.
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView request builder, launch/preflight copy, Launch partial, updated tests, and generated summaries in this packet. Backend and PowerShell keep-original guards from prior work remain the lower-level safety controls.
notes: The running desktop backend may need a restart to load the current Python guard and refreshed WebView assets before retrying CSV rerun start.
